name: Iseuri

name: Sajiloni

name: Eiti
description: Focal zone for SheRISE adolescent mother re-enrollments into secondary schooling and vocational enterprise pathways.

name: Saina
description: Location of intensive cross-village parent-teacher workshops dismantling menstrual taboos.

name: Iltilal
description: Border community site operating joint inter-agency intercept networks against cross-border cut caravans.

name: Paranae
description: Active cluster for foundational literacy regrouping, accelerating reading fluency for young primary girls.

name: Eluai
meaning: Abode of the yellow whistling thorn
description: Sanctuary corridor providing safe transit and academic catch-up coaching for rescued out-of-school girls.

name: Oloosuyian
meaning: Place of the wild hunting dogs
description: Youth leadership hub where Sauti Ya Dada advocates mentor younger primary school students on bodily autonomy.

name: Orkung'u

name: Piliwa

name: Kumpa

name: Ilbisil
description: Economic epicenter where teen mothers from the SheRISE program sell artisan beadwork, tailoring, and ceramic crafts.

name: Olmotiany
description: Grassroots assembly center where community champions monitor girl retention rates across 5 partner primary schools.
